origin: Own exact four-neuron binary population-code oracle in a fixed time bin. Neural labels are anonymous and carry no organism, anatomical, stimulation or biological engineering target. All response probabilities and detector errors are constructed exact model inputs, not finite-recording estimates. The task concerns statistical sensory coding, calibrated observation and information-focused detector allocation.
stimulus_and_patterns: StimulusS has known priorP(S=0)=0.4,P(S=1)=0.6. A true neural responseX has four binary spike indicators[X1,X2,X3,X4] for[N1,N2,N3,N4] in one common time bin. Its unknown conditional law may be ANY distribution on16patterns. The CSV lists P(Y=y|S=s), whereY is the detected spike pattern. Patterns are FOUR-CHARACTER BINARY STRINGS retaining leadingzeros. Required report order is lexicographic0000,0001,...,1111 withN1leftmost. Do not treat these labels as decimal counts or sort numerically after dropping positions. Both full16-pattern conditional distributions are required.
detector_calibration: Detector errors are independent across neurons conditional on trueX, independent ofS, and constant across bins. False-positivealpha=P(Y_i=1|X_i=0) in N1..N4order is[0.05,0.10,0.15,0.02]; false-negativebeta=P(Y_i=0|X_i=1) is[0.15,0.05,0.05,0.18]. The individual2x2column-stochastic matrix has rowsY_i=0,1andcolumnsX_i=0,1: [[1-alpha_i,beta_i],[alpha_i,1-beta_i]]. Build the FULL16x16independent product channelD with rowsy,columnsx in the declared pattern order. Retain actual MatrixSVD and MatrixInverse ofD, and actual MatrixMultiply of the returned inverse times the16x2observed conditional-probability columns. Audit invertibility, recovered nonnegative normalized laws, all source identities and exact forward reconstruction. Do not subtract one scalar false-positive rate from a joint probability.
information_estimands: Use Shannon mutual information I(S;R)=sum_s,r p(s)p(r|s)log2[p(r|s)/sum_sprime p(sprime)p(r|sprime)], with0log0=0. This is an exact model functional, not a finite-sample plug-in estimate or a significance test. Compute it for full trueX, full detectedY, detected parity(sum_iY_i mod2), and EVERY nonempty true-neuron subset. In the subset-information output, maskm=1..15containsN_i when bit(i-1)isone; full response ismask15. Retain all marginal probabilities and normalization. Derive the smallest informative subset and largest proper-subset information from the complete finite family or exact marginal identities. Check data processing for the fixed detector channel. Statistical sufficiency of detected parity means equality of the FULL stimulus posterior: P(S|Y=y)=P(S|parity(Y)=parity(y)) at every positive-probability pattern. This posterior criterion is stronger than obtaining the same0-1decoding accuracy under one fixed prior; evaluate the two quantities separately.
higher_order_code_and_maximum_entropy: Define r_i=(-1)^X_i and Walsh featurephi_A=product_iinA r_i for every nonempty neuron subsetA. Compute all conditional moments through order4, and report the conditional fourth moments for both stimuli. Are pairwise conditional independence and all-four conditional independence the same conclusion? Construct the conditional MAXIMUM ENTROPY response law matching ALL moments through order3 separately for each stimulus, and compute the stimulus information of that selected model. Prove the entropy optimum and uniqueness on the full16-state support; one fitted pairwise model is not proof of absent high-order information. Distinguish an approximation selected from incomplete moments from the actually deconvolved full law.
decoder_audit: Use the stated unequal stimulus prior to derive Bayes-optimal0-1accuracies for trueX and detectedY. Compare two logistic feature families for TRUE responses: all14nonempty Walsh features of order<=3, and these same14features plus the fourth-order featuremask15. Feature order ismask1..14then15, with integer targetstimulus0or1. For each family the ANALYTIC fitting target is the minimum of population binomial negative loglikelihood, equivalently EXPECTED CROSS-ENTROPY; the requested accuracy is the classification accuracy AT THAT loss-minimizing parameter. It is not the maximum0-1accuracy over all parameter thresholds in that feature family. Retain TWO actual FitLogisticRegression calls withregularization_c=1000,max_iterations=1000, then actual PredictLogisticModel withEACH returned model on all16patterns in its feature order. Evaluate actual model decisions with ClassificationMetrics on the exact weighted replication below. Keep analytic population optima, regularized solver diagnostics and Bayes0-1decision optima distinct; none establishes held-out performance in new recordings.
weighted_replication_and_analytic_decode: For tools requiring labelled rows, verify that200*P(S=s)*P(X=x|S=s)is a nonnegative integer for EVERY reconstructed(s,x), then expand exactly those weights to200rows and build both feature matrices from this SAME joint law. These are a finite representation of the constructed probabilities, not independent biological recordings or Monte Carlo data. Prove the unique UNREGULARIZED population CROSS-ENTROPY minimizer for each feature family, using its full gradient/Hessian or equivalent finite-support convex argument. Report classification accuracy at those minimizers and the raw(unstandardized)intercept/coefficient of the fourth-order-only class1logit. A decoder that instead optimizes discontinuous0-1error solves a different problem. L2solver coefficients and training-fitted feature centering need convention audits; they are not exact analytic gold. Failure of a fitted restricted decoder does not establish absence of stimulus information.
detector_upgrade_design: The true neural law stays fixed. You may replace selected detectors by perfectX_i=Y_i readout; unselected detectors retain their ORIGINAL independent errors. Upgrade costsN1..N4=[2,2,1,1], totalcost<=3. Define objective as FULL resulting four-detector pattern informationI(S;Y_upgraded), not information in one cell or in observed parity. Enumerate EVERY feasible upgrade subset, includingnone, recomputing its full product channel and full information; return the keyed map, every optimal set, its cost and objective. Canonical map key isascendingNIDsjoinedby+or none. Exact ties must be retained. A cost/gain heuristic is not a global certificate.
greedy_comparison: Separately run gain-per-costgreedy fromnone: at each step choose an available upgrade maximizing [I(S;Y_after)-I(S;Y_current)]/cost, withties resolved by ascendingneuronID; choose only upgrades fitting the remainingbudget, and stop if none fit. Report the ORDER, finalcost/objective and whether it is globally optimal. Use actual recomputed joint information after each choice, not sums of initial individual gains. Explain how higher-order coding can make individually uninformative neurons valuable in a joint recording and why detector upgrade value is different from a single-neuron coding score.

interpretation_proposals.A: No single neuron information does not imply no information in a jointly recorded neural population.
interpretation_proposals.B: Conditional independence of every pair guarantees conditional mutual independence of all four neurons.
interpretation_proposals.C: A maximum-entropy model selected from low-order moments has identified every higher-order feature of the true response law.
interpretation_proposals.D: Known asymmetric observation errors can make detected parity discard stimulus information that remains in the full detected pattern.
interpretation_proposals.E: The exact supplied detector channel cannot increase information aboutS relative to the full true response.
interpretation_proposals.F: Greedy incremental information per unit upgrade cost is a proof of global optimality under every finite detector budget.
interpretation_proposals.G: A neural decoder fitted to replicated constructed probability weights establishes held-out performance in a new biological recording.
interpretation_proposals.H: A high-order statistical population code does not by itself identify anatomical or causal interactions between the neurons.

reporting: Use the public JSON schema. Conditional response arrays have stimulusrows[0,1]andthe16declaredpatterncolumns; every row is normalized within1e-8and lies in[0,1]. All information isbits and must respect nonnegative/data-processing bounds up to numerical reporting precision. Analytic logit israwclass1log-odds withfourthfeaturephi_1234=(-1)^(X1+X2+X3+X4). Upgrade sets are unordered internally and externally; greedyorder is ordered. Numeric tolerance1e-7 for exact information/probability/accuracy values,1e-6for logit parameters; solver coefficients themselves are not final answer targets. Full inverse/normalization, all moment/entropy/decoder and finite design certificates remain in the trajectory.

primary_context.title: Synergy, Redundancy, and Independence in Population Codes
primary_context.role: Primary conceptual context for neural population information beyond individual responses and distinctions between statistical independence notions. The four-neuron law, error channel, constructed probability table and upgrade budget are own; no empirical neural recordings or paper numerical results are copied.
